SIX
FIFTH DRAFT CHARACTER BIBLE
Written by Amber Reed and Helena Sharp
Film App Upload Edition
This bible is built to function as a character continuity source for casting, image generation, shot generation, wardrobe, voice, and performance. The Fifth Draft controls story continuity. Where the screenplay does not specify a physical trait, the appearance below is explicitly a production recommendation so the app can preserve a consistent visual identity rather than inventing a new face from shot to shot.
Family resemblance rule: T and Kendrick should read immediately as full brothers through shared eye shape, smile line, or cheek structure from Monique despite very different bodies. The other biological Cole sons may share subtler Isaiah traits. Mak should feel unquestionably like family through presence, behavior and decades of shared styling, while visually resembling Evelyn strongly enough that the late parentage reveal remains plausible rather than visually obvious from frame one.
Timeline rule: create separate locked references for the 2018 and 2026 versions of the six brothers. Preserve bone structure, scars, gait and identifying hair traits while aging naturally. Do not simply make the adult faces smaller or smoother.
